figure_type.original: Rectangle ABCD with interior polyline A-E-C (shallow bend at E), segment EB, and right-angle mark at E between EA and EB. No arcs.

issues.description: Stroke weight of the rectangle edges and interior lines is visibly thinner in the render than in the original (render strokes look roughly 2px versus about 3px in the original panel).
issues.suggestion: Increase line width slightly, e.g. from line width=1.5pt to about 2pt, if matching the original weight is required.

issues.description: The A-E stroke in the render appears slightly bowed near A, though the TikZ source draws (A)--(E) as a straight segment. This may be a rasterisation artifact, but the original's A-E is a straight line with a clean kink at E.
issues.suggestion: Verify the render at higher resolution. If the bow persists, check for a stray curve or smoothing (e.g. line join=round interacting with the shallow bend) and keep A-E straight.
